children: is attracting fresh capital from Cathie Wood's ARK Invest after the chipmaker delivered another strong quarter and raised expectations for its next stage of AI-driven growth.

ARK purchased 243,707 Nvidia shares worth about $55.6 million across five ETFs. The move came two days after Nvidia reported fiscal second-quarter revenue of $96.2 billion, a 106% increase from a year earlier.

Data Center revenue reached $89 billion, up 117% year over year, while non-GAAP earnings per share rose to $2.22. Nvidia expects current-quarter revenue of about $108 billion, above the latest Wall Street estimate cited by Reuters.

The company has also projected roughly 70% revenue growth for fiscal 2028, pointing to continued spending on AI computing infrastructure. Nvidia faces potential pressure from memory costs and export restrictions, however, which could affect margins and international sales.

ARK's latest purchase adds to its exposure following the earnings report. While the trade does not disclose the investment rationale, the timing places Nvidia's forward growth outlook at the center of attention.
ARK's purchase adds a positive investor signal as Nvidia backs its valuation with elevated AI revenue expectations.

title: Cathie Wood Snaps Up $55 Million of Red-Hot Chip Stock
